_comment: TableFrame.height: a total-height target that proportionally scales whatever row heights were measured/given (mirrors TableFrame.width, which already did this for columns). Unlike the earlier fill-target-height case (explicit rowHeights[] summing to a target, computed by hand), here the three rows have DIFFERENT natural heights and no rowHeights override at all -- height:240 alone stretches all three proportionally taller than their natural sum.

children.text: a row with more text that wraps onto two lines
